description: Procurement of 218,000 Colistimethate Sodium Injection 1,000,000 IU Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Colistimethate is an antibiotic used to treat severe infections caused by susceptible strains of certain gram-negative bacteria. In view of the need for the said drug, international competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 218,000 vials of colistimethate sodium vaccine 1,000,000 IU and six (06) bids have been received for the same. Taking into account the recommendations made by the Procurement Appeal Board pertaining to the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to M/s Ceyoka (Pvt) Ltd. of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Ciron Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd., India) for a total cost of Rs. 32.48 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
